testcase.name: Scenario: Open a ribbon context menu while the panel selector is open: target/native-scratch.HSqCy5/current-ribbon-panel-visibility-source/features/application/ribbon-panel-visibility/ribbon-panel-visibility.feature:460:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: Open a ribbon context menu while the panel selector is open ✔ Given `fixtures/cad/blank-metric-part.opd` is open and active ✔ And the full Tools ribbon is visible ✔ And the direct panel selector is open ✔ When the user right-clicks the Options panel title ✔ Then the panel selector closes ✔ And the ribbon context menu opens ✔ And the context menu offers Ribbon Appearance, Show Panels, Customize User Commands, Undock Ribbon and Docking Positions ✔ And Show Panel Titles is checked ✔ When the user presses Escape ✔ Then the ribbon context menu closes ✔ And the Tools ribbon remains visible
